newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal operator installs phone tapping equipment.
newsitem.headline: Portugal operator installs phone tapping equipment.

text.p: Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel-Telecomunicacoes Pessoais said it had decided to install technology to permit phone tapping.
"Telecel is making every effort to install the equipment this year, in time for the January 31 1997 deadline set by the Portugal Communications Institute (ICP)," a statement said.
Earlier this month the Portuguese government ordered mobile phone operators to install the technology to permit phone tapping and help police fight increasingly powerful international drug gangs.
